text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day,
while accompanying Rose Kingdom on
a stroll through the city streets.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up,
the New Year's Grand Raffle is officially
open~!
And the grand prize is none other than a
'Hot Springs Trip Ticket'!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
First prize is a 'Special Deluxe Carrot
Hamburg Steak'!
Second prize is a 'Heaping Mountain of
Carrots'!
Third prize is 'A Single Carrot'!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, it's our fun-filled raffle!
Anyone and everyone is welcome~!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. A "fukubiki" lottery, is it?
I have heard of the concept.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Dating back to the Nara period,
it was an auspicious parlor game played with
poetry slips for New Year's festivities,
was it not?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still,
it was likely a bit different from what she
imagined.
I explained the lottery wheel to her,
emphasizing that it was a much lighter,
more common form of amusement.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. So one rotates that octagonal...
lottery machine, yes?
choice_data_list: Would you care to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anticipating such an occasion,
I brought along the raffle ticket I had
gotten the other day.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you.
Will you entrust your destiny to me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Full of vigor, Rose Kingdom turned
the lottery crank!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulaaaations!!
We have our grand prize winner for the 'Hot
Springs Trip Voucher'~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am astonished.
It seems I have drawn an unexpectedly grand
prize.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, a 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', hm?
It seems there is plenty of time before it
expires.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It seems they even offer rose baths depending
on the season.
Floating some six hundred fresh blossoms,
they say.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once the Twinkle Series has quieted down,
let us go together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to add,
“Perhaps you might invite your schoolmates
rather than someone like myself”――

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
So you would reject my wish?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Heh.
Forgive me, merely a jest.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because you are the Trainer
who has shared in my trials and triumphs
that I wish to share in our leisure together
as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Please, keep some time open for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so it was decided that once things
settled down,
we would take a hot spring trip together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, first prize~!
Your prize is the 'Special Deluxe Carrot
Salisbury Steak'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
First prize, is it?
I wonder which of us possesses such fortune—
you, or I?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"'A hamburger steak kneaded from A5-rank
Kuroge Wagyu and premium pork.
The specially crafted demi-glace sauce pairs
exquisitely
with white rice'—"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(...
It looks familiar somehow—no,
is it merely my imagination?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, forgive me.
It is a splendid delicacy,
after all.
Let us savor it together tonight.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
An astonishing amount of meat juice bursts
forth. Just as the instructions noted,
the sauce pairs exquisitely with white
rice.
I could easily find myself asking for a
second bowl――

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No—so it truly is as I thought.
I wondered if it was merely my
imagination...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It tastes just like the Salisbury steak
from the Western diner I used to frequent.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It was a downtown yoshoku diner—
an unusual spot for our family.
Yet the food was exquisite, and my parents
often brought me there as a regular.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Knowing I was at a growing age,
they would sometimes kindly give me an
extra-large helping of rice.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The owner closed up shop citing advanced age,
you see.
I found myself feeling dreadfully lonely
about it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To think the day would come when I could
eat it again.
And yet, why—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked up information based on the shop
name
written in the instruction manual.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To think,
the son had carried on the family recipe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they had just opened a Western-style
restaurant
in the shopping district specializing in
Salisbury steak,
and happened to be helping out with the
lottery this time.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Now it makes sense.
No wonder the flavor tasted so familiar.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The shopping district...
Then I can visit again.
—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
You have given me an unexpected pleasure to
look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Still,
to think I would draw such a fateful
prize.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a 'Heaping Mountain of
Carrots'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, this quantity of carrots...
Shall we bring them back to the main
estate?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—To cross paths with you beneath this twilight
sky...
My dear friend.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet—
An Umamusume close with Rose Kingdom,
possessing a peculiar way of speaking and
an eccentric worldview.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh!
From the look of things,
you seem to have wandered into a labyrinth,
have you not?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet-senpai—
Yes, in truth...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuku, I see!
Truly—the guidance of destiny itself!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...? Guidance, you say?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I was wandering the wastes,
in search of an abundant bounty of
carrots.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am currently concocting a new mocktail.
My ideal—a carotene-rich libation
starring none other than the noble carrot.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The more carrots, the better.
Provided you have no objections,
I shall purchase them all.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...!
Indeed,
what an extraordinary twist of fate.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I always thoroughly enjoy your mocktails,
Senpai.
Please,
allow me to present you with this gift.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I see... You have my gratitude.
Once it is finished,
I shall deliver it to you first.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A peerless cup—
magnificent enough to shatter common sense
itself!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Destroying common sense, is it?
Ha-ha, that sounds just like you,
Gimlet-senpai.
I eagerly await it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later,
the delivered mocktail was
a refreshingly sweet-and-sour creation—
an exquisite flavor
that truly shattered conventional wisdom,
or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Third prize~!
Your prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Carrots, was it—
I recall hearing of them from Grandmamma
once.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A panacea widely used since millennia past
for the prevention and treatment of all
manner of ailments—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It seems that before their cultivation began,
they were exceedingly rare
and commandingly expensive.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Above all, its appearance and name.
—Written with the characters for "person"
and "to bow down," "ninjin."
...Do you not find it resembles something?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, a human.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is even a legend that Korean ginseng
actually sprouts legs and flees into the
woods to escape harvest. However—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For some time now,
a thought had lingered in my mind.
Was it truly nothing more than a legend?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
They say certain algae can move via the
action of flagella.
Though it depends on what one defines as a
'plant,'
can you truly claim with certainty that they
never move?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps by spending a moment with this carrot,
its true intent may reveal itself to me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being a completely baseless
claim,
the sheer intensity of the question made me
flinch in spite of myself.
Was it serious, or was it a joke—?
choice_data_list: That might be a bit much... don't ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Forgive me—
I indulged in teasing you a bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Carrots do not move. Yet,
they brim with nourishment.
Tonight, I shall partake with gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Here's a pack of tissues for
participating~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Obtained <itemname>.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A blank, is it?
I suppose fortune does not favor me so
easily.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, being able to enjoy the raffle
was a pleasant experience.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I would like to draw something
other than 'pocket tissues'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Rose Kingdom looked
somewhat disappointed...
